certifiedResults.caveat: Certified 2024 Statement of Vote town President rows are active and reconcile exactly to 1,759,275 printed votes. They contain 265 more votes than EMS version 80741, which remains active only for U.S. Senate comparison and turnout fields. The nine result rows are current Census planning-region aggregates of the 169 certified town rows.

reviewCharts.warning: Connecticut review rows compare certified Statement of Vote town President values with EMS version 80741 U.S. Senate values and fuse Christopher S. Murphy Democratic and Working Families ballot lines by person. They are town-level public-interest screening inputs only, not precinct-level findings.

turnout.notes: Connecticut EMS turnout rows use EV as registered/elector denominator and VV as voters checked. All rows are warning-required until EMS field semantics and Statement-of-Vote/EAC differences are reviewed.

geometry.notes: The active map uses nine current Census planning-region county-equivalent features. The crosswalk uses the 169 non-placeholder town/MCD features and each feature's Census COUNTY/GEOID to aggregate results to those regions. Retired eight-county EMS labels remain source metadata only.

historicalBaselines.warning: Connecticut historical baselines are official EMS 2016 and 2020 town President results aggregated reproducibly to the nine current Census planning-region county-equivalents for jurisdictionTag comparisons. Planning regions were not the historical election reporting units. Official 2012 rows remain uncollected.
